name: random_advice
description: Get a random piece of advice. Returns the advice text and slip ID for reference or follow-up queries.

name: search_advice
description: Search for advice by keyword or phrase (e.g., "confidence", "relationships"). Returns matching advice slips with text and IDs.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for within advice text.

name: get_advice
description: Get a specific advice slip by its numeric ID (e.g., "42"). Returns the full advice text.

id.description: The numeric ID of the advice slip to retrieve.
